5 Ways Heroes of the Storm Cured my MOBAphobia

I've been saying it since I got into the Beta, If HOTS was not a Blizzard game, no one would care, it would of been ripped apart for being too different.

Though I can appreciate the game being easier in general, as players don't need to learn items, it annoys me that whilst you can have many different build, there are only really 1 good build per hero.

I put about 10 hours into HotS and I can honestly say I thought it the worst of the MOBAs I've played. They took away any sense of individual skill/identity in favor of a combined team level that encourages a certain style of play I absolutely hated. Yes, I'm a team player so what I mean by that is in other MOBAs, supports would not have a problem taking a dive so their carry will live on but this game lacks the incentive to prioritize the support death over the carry due to the shared level/lack of personal resource mechanics.

I really wanted to like this game, I tried. But the insane pay wall, the dull hero mechanic design, and the lack of FUN I had was just too much.

Strife pulled what this game aimed to be off a lot better. For the record, I am a 10 year DotA veteran and a ... since beta League player.
I really don't like MOBAs and I'm interested in playing more of HoTS.
